invalidation_rule: Any material edit of this package requires a new package_version and a new hash. An already-accepted prior contract pinned to provisional-v1 is not rewritten. LEGAL_APPROVED, TAX_APPROVED, PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED and CHECKOUT_AUTHORIZED are never implied by a founder baseline.

decisions.required_evidence: Contrato social, cartão CNPJ or other authorized societal/Asaas official-account document stating exact legal name and CNPJ of the contracting provider. Trade name CONFENGE, public website, personal memory and marketing copy are not sources.
Registered headquarters address from the same authorized societal document, then a proposed forum derived from that sede. Counsel validates efficacy. No comarca may be invented.
Counsel review of ceiling efficacy and carve-outs. Founder baseline is commercial only.
decisions.baseline: One-off ceiling limited to the amount actually paid on the affected OS, preserving non-limitable exceptions, dolo/fraude, confidencialidade/LGPD, IP and integrity. Not LEGAL_APPROVED.

decisions.required_evidence: Counsel review of refund/cancellation wording. Founder baseline is commercial only.
decisions.baseline: Undue/duplicate charge: reconcile and return. CONFENGE refuses before start: full return. After start: settle demonstrably executed work and return any positive balance. No automatic full refund.

decisions.required_evidence: None for the commercial window already in the catalog. Counsel may still review contractual wording.
decisions.baseline: 10 to 15 business days after alignment, complete brief/data and acceptance. Obligation of means. Not a guaranteed result.

decisions.required_evidence: Counsel review of LGPD inventory vs actual collection. Founder baseline lists typical B2B data only.
decisions.baseline: Corporate name and contact, role, company/CNPJ, contractual/fiscal data, supplied brief/files, communications and acceptance metadata. Do not request sensitive data by default.

decisions.required_evidence: Named Brazilian counsel written retention periods for lead and one-off dossier, coordinated with accountant on fiscal-document retention. Do not invent a number.
Named accountant/responsável fiscal, CRC or equivalent identification, and dated answers to ACCOUNTANT_HANDOFF.md. Do not invent a name.
Counsel review of electronic-acceptance efficacy. Founder baseline is commercial only.
decisions.baseline: Acceptance = OS/proposal + terms_version + scope_version + hashes + authorized representative/CNPJ + timestamp + durable copy. Checkout/callback alone is not acceptance.

decisions.required_evidence: None unless a different canonical channel already exists in commercial authority. Governance README lists the same address; no conflicting canonical was found.
